prompt:
Create ONE production-ready 2D animation character pose asset for the short film "来电", using the attached images as identity and drawing-style references. The first reference is the approved grandmother full-body puppeteer; the second is her expression sheet. This is the SAME elderly Chinese grandmother, not a redesign.

New pose for shot S12: full-body grandmother KNEELING AND SITTING BACK ON HER HEELS, seen in a clear right-facing side view very slightly three-quarter so both hands and folded legs remain readable. She is next to an unseen wooden storage box in front of her to screen right, in the moment of gently lifting a shadow puppet out. Draw ONLY the complete grandmother and the two short bamboo pieces in her hands. The compositor will add the wooden box, crane puppet, long rods, lighting and setting later. Do NOT draw any box, crane, bird, lamp, furniture, floor line, scene, cast shadow, text, panel, or extra object. Leave clean empty pale gray space in front of and above her hands for the future crane.

Match the references closely: soft elderly cheek and nose shape, thin round black glasses, fine age lines, warm gentle focused expression with a small closed mouth, gray swept-back hair in a low bun with the same three red beads. Her gaze follows the empty space just in front of and above her two hands. Preserve blue short-sleeve buttoned blouse with simple white five-petal flowers, loose dark navy trousers, black cloth shoes with pale soles. Clean restrained dark outlines, flat cel colors, small simple fabric folds, neutral soft flat light, no dramatic shading or baked warm lamp light.

Pose anatomy and balance are crucial. Her hips rest naturally over her folded heels, thighs slope forward toward the knees, both lower legs fold back under her; normal relaxed elderly kneeling posture with a gentle slight torso lean forward, no floating hips, no enormous thighs, no broken knees, no squatting, no cross-legged sitting, no chair. Show the entire head and bun, both hands and wrists, both knees and both feet/shoes inside the frame with a small safe margin. The far lower leg/foot can partially overlap but must remain anatomically understandable. Keep normal mature body proportions.

Two arms, two hands ONLY. Arms reach forward naturally and are separated with a clear gap; elbows comfortably bent, one hand slightly higher at lower chest level and the other at waist level, as if each is lifting one control rod. Hands are small believable older hands with correctly bent fingers and relaxed wrapped grips, no stretched thumb, fused fingers, extra fingers or enormous palms. Each hand holds ONE separate thin straight bamboo stick, a SHORT visible stub only: a little bamboo protrudes beyond each side of that fist, and both visible ends of that SAME stick lie on exactly one straight axis through the closed grip. The sticks do not fork, bend, cross, join, or extend into long rods. They point gently forward/upward to screen right; their precise axes must be easy for the compositor to extend. Avoid a separate off-axis stray tail behind either fist.

Laterality is mandatory and follows the first reference: the NEAR arm/hand, visibly connected to the near sleeve on the viewer side, is her anatomical RIGHT and has NO bracelet. The FAR arm/hand is her anatomical LEFT and wears exactly ONE simple green jade bangle. Do not mirror the character, do not put a bangle on the near wrist, do not duplicate the bangle.

One isolated full figure on a plain uniform light gray background, landscape composition around 1536 by 1024 if supported, with the kneeling figure filling most of the image height and sufficient clear space to screen right. Keep the native output resolution without upscaling. No labels, no border, no collage.
